references.text: Parallel account of the Israelites' defeat against the Amorites and Amalekites at Hormah, where they were turned back after attempting to go up into the Promised Land against God's will.
Hormah is mentioned as the place where Israel later defeated the Canaanites, the same place referred to in this verse.
The Amorites chased the Israelites in a similar way at Ai, where they pursued them down the slope.
Bees are used as an image of enemies who surround and attack, the same imagery found in Deuteronomy.
Bees are used as a symbol for hostile nations that the Lord calls forth, corresponding to the image of the Amorites pursuing like bees.
Victory is mentioned as the territory of the Amorites, the same area referred to in this verse.
